Semester plan

This is an unofficial planning tool, not a degree audit. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the University of Illinois. Your official requirements live in your college\'s degree audit and with your academic advisor — confirm anything here before you register or apply to graduate. Programs and requirements come from the uploaded 2026–2027 catalog requirement dataset; courses, prerequisites, and gen-ed designations from the uploaded course datasets. Free-text requirement rules that cannot be resolved to course codes are listed for you to confirm, never counted automatically. Placeholder codes like MATH 4-- mean "any 400-level MATH"; a 4-- placeholder fills any elective slot at the 400 level or below. AP, IB, transfer, and proficiency credit go in the "Credit you already have" card and count toward requirements like any other course — the catalog awards equivalency by score, so add the specific course each score cleared.
